E442.name: Ammonium Phosphatides (E442)
E442.long_term_effects: An artificial emulsifier mostly used in chocolate. Safe in normal amounts, but heavily processed.

E471.name: Mono- and Diglycerides (E471)
E471.long_term_effects: Used to mix water and oil. It can contain hidden trans fats, which are bad for heart health if eaten daily.

E476.name: PGPR (E476)
E476.long_term_effects: Often used as a cheap chemical replacement for real cocoa butter. Best to limit in a healthy diet.

Artificial Flavouring Substances.name: Artificial Flavours
Artificial Flavouring Substances.long_term_effects: Lab-made chemicals used to mimic real food flavors. They offer zero nutrition and encourage eating ultra-processed foods.
